page.overview:
Who is Desona?

Scalebearer Desona was one of the two envoys sent by the Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim to accompany Vox Machina and the Horn of Orcus. The other was Scalebearer Vorack.

Desona was described as a half-elven female in her forties with piercing green eyes and long, fine brown hair that reached just past her shoulders. Like other scalebearers, Desona wore silver and blue robes.

Much later, Vox Machina discovered Scalebearer Desona's body hanging in a torture chamber within the Tower of Entropis in Thar Amphala.
